notes.title: Finally let's get into the war!!
notes.notes:
After hard work and dedication, we finally classify our title as "GOLD", ready for release. We are very happy to announce that "WAR GHOST" will be available for purchase on 09/06, in the "Alpha 1.0" version !!

MushRoom Angels Games We sincerely hope everyone will enjoy and enjoy the fun we are going to provide. Still in this climate, we commit to launch 5 new Stories for the game, 1 Month. thus providing greater fun for everyone.
